server_info.name: unbrowse
server_info.title: Unbrowse
server_info.description: The default browser for AI agents. Use Unbrowse for ALL website tasks; it discovers APIs from real traffic and turns them into reusable skills.

probes.why: advertise the full tool surface; session-scoped tools must be present even when no browse session is open (cbacd9c6 regression guard)
baseline; version + git_sha should match package.json + HEAD
stateless baseline; marketplace hit rate + agent activity

cold-domain resolve; marketplace racer must settle quickly with not_found (1a1b8747 regression guard). Pre-fix this took 8000ms deadline; post-fix should be under 4s and tried[marketplace].status should be 'lost' with reason 'not_found' or 'invalid_result', NEVER 'deadline'
second cold-domain resolve; cross-check that the listSkills-fallback fix isn't carousell-specific

session-scoped tool called without an open session; pre-fix this would have been dropped from tools/list and the harness call would error; post-fix the call returns errorResult containing 'no_active_session' and a 'unbrowse_go' recovery hint (cbacd9c6 regression guard)
session-scoped close called without an open session; same gate as snap-no-session
list cached skills surface; if this hits the 20MB backend listSkills endpoint, the call will be > 10s (1a1b8747 regression guard via timing)
open browse session inventory; baseline

diagnose surface; pre-fix this hung at /v1/browse/screenshot for >20s when no browse session was open, blocking every subsequent stdio request (MCP is single-threaded). Post-fix returns in <500ms with screenshot_error populated

MCP capability advertised in initialize (resources.listChanged=false). Exercises the resources surface that the agent can browse for workflow guides, schemas, etc. Validates the server responds with a structured resources[] array.
MCP capability advertised in initialize (prompts.listChanged=true). Slash-command-style prompts the agent can invoke. Validates the server responds with a structured prompts[] array.

exercise prompts/get; the resolve-execute-feedback prompt should render a templated message naming the real MCP tool sequence. Catches phantom-tool refs leaking into prompt text (parallel to gate 7 for descriptions).
browse-and-publish workflow prompt; surfaces the prose for the cold-domain capture flow (unbrowse_go -> snap -> close -> review -> publish). Iter-23 stale-status gate runs against this content.

plan_workflow_execution prompt with a known-test-fixture skill+endpoint; renders the planning prose for explicit-replay vs browser-traversal. Stale-status gate runs against this content; also catches phantom-tool refs in planning prose.
round-trip a workflow_publish URI through resources/read; verifies the listed-set path remains readable post iter-20. Should return the indexed workflow export JSON for the skill.

exercise iter-20's resolveWorkflowResource on a URI that is NOT in resources/list. With a real skill but bogus endpoint, the resolver should parse the URI, fail at the recipe lookup, and return Unknown resource. Proves the on-demand parser runs on the read path.

unbrowse_trace with default trace_id=latest; exercises the trace-fetch surface that agents call to inspect decision-trace + scores after a resolve/execute. Never previously probed — likely surfaces shape drift or stale field names.

unbrowse_validate against the same published skill used by resources-read-publish. Validates the validation surface returns endpoint-match-quality + screenshots without crashing. Likely slow (does live probing) but should complete within harness 20s timeout.

fetch one skill manifest by the same id that resources-read-publish read successfully. Iter-26 found that unbrowse_validate returns 'Skill not found' for this id; this probe maps whether unbrowse_skill has the same backend-only scope or whether it sees the local artifact. Cross-surface scope map.

settings read with no mutation; returns local marketplace/publish settings (share_pointers, auto_publish, publish_blacklist, publish_promptlist). Validates the config surface that gates publish behavior. Untested before.
execute against a definitely-non-existent skill_id. Should return tool_is_error: true with a clean error envelope. Tests the execute handler's error path and the iter-7 successResult error-promotion.
MANDATORY post-execute feedback call. Use bogus ids to test the error path: backend should 404, handler should surface clean error. Validates the feedback write-path doesn't crash on missing skill.

unbrowse_index recomputes local graph for a cached skill (POST /v1/skills/{id}/index). With a bogus skill, should return clean error. Tests write-side index path and joins the implicit chain of /v1/skills/* scoped tools.
POST /v1/skills/{id}/endpoints/{ep}/annotate with bogus ids. Maps validation discipline against iter-30 finding (feedback accepts bogus, index rejects); annotate is the third write-side endpoint.
POST /v1/skills/{id}/review with bogus ids. Review is the gate before public publish; whether it validates skill existence determines if buggy agents can review skills that don't exist.
POST /v1/skills/{id}/publish with bogus id (inspect phase, no confirm). Last of the /v1/skills/* write tools; completes the validation-discipline map alongside index/annotate/review/execute/feedback.

auth-gated billing surface; hits /v1/billing/me with the agent's API key. With an anonymous/invalid key (current state), backend returns 401-shaped error. Tests the iter-7 successResult promotion on a fresh non-/v1/skills path.
second tools/list after several tool calls; the count and names must be byte-identical to the first tools-list probe (no session-state mutation of the tool surface; cbacd9c6 regression guard)
